Repository eligible only with an in-window first-parent pair, exact original Git commit/tree byte hashes and license bytes. For each repo choose lexically earliest(committer_timestamp,SHA) eligible first-parent pair. Choose the first8eligible evaluation repositories in the fixed pool order, without viewing model results. source_family_boundary: No calibration repository or exact source object may appear in evaluation. Repository identity is a proxy, not an independently certified statistical family.
task_assignment: For each fixed source slot, kind cycles new_fact, correction, composition, procedure. Git commit/tree identities become reversible declared site_/mode_ identifiers. Event schema, revision, supersedes, first-hop and relation traversal meanings are frozen to original controlled event semantics. Procedure uses only fixed read-only git cat-file object-type checks with original stdout/stderr/exitcode. No repository-supplied code or model-generated command is executed.
task_construction_limit: External facts must bind original Git object byte spans and explicit field mapping. No invented commit, tree, ancestry, timestamp, license or success. Source-derived event records are labeled projections, never originals.
